------------------------
----DataBase Credential
------------------------

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL sv_CRED
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

------------------------
----Data Source
------------------------
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver_source
WITH 
(
    LOCATION ='https://raw0data0source.blob.core.windows.net/silver',
    CREDENTIAL = sv_CRED
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE gold_source
WITH 
(
    LOCATION ='https://raw0data0source.blob.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = sv_CRED
)

------------------------
----EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT
------------------------
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT PARQUET
WITH 
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET
)
